PluginData.Description: Ship navigation, signal intercept, velocity matching and docking. MAX SIG 0 is unrestricted; saved limits remain intact. Departure/arrival limits hold throughout their zones, with transition ramps outside. Improved motion recovery, intercept engagement, stalled-turn handling and ETA presentation. Matching capture-safe external HUD. Windows / Pulsar Legacy. Disable older local Nav entries before enabling this catalog entry. Offline validated; test flight behavior in creative first.
